how: Headed Chromium 154 on camera Pi 2's desktop (labwc, headless 1920x1080 output), driven from the runner over the DevTools protocol through an SSH tunnel to 127.0.0.1:9222. Pages were reached by mouse moves along curved paths, mouse clicks and typed searches (Playwright page.mouse / page.keyboard), not by URL, except for returning to a category page. Downloads capped at 300 KB/s, Chromium at nice 19 with software rendering and a throwaway profile in /tmp, deleted afterwards.
pi_side_effects: DigiKey answered with a Cloudflare check. While it ran, the 1 GB board's swap filled (989 of 989 MB) and its load reached 10, so Chromium was closed after one attempt. The livestream (rpicam-vid and picam-stream/device.py) kept running. Chromium was then restarted with one renderer and closed again at the end; nothing else on the Pi was changed.
pololu_sale: Pololu's Black Friday sale was running; the prices below are the ones shown on the product pages.
